scope_note: Area 3 point of dispensing: prospective drug review and the patient profile, the label and dispensing record, and counseling. New sections with no prior audit. Declined: MA-COMPOUND-LABEL-CONTACT against SG-MA-DISPENSING-LABEL-AND-RECORD -- the section's declared scope is the s. 21 container label for ordinary dispensing, and it says expressly that the compounded-preparation labeling and pharmacy-contact paragraphs of s. 21 are compounding practice outside it; no section teaches that rule yet, which is recorded as coverage debt. MA-SCHEDULE-VI-VALIDITY (247 CMR 9.04(12) and (15)) is taught in SG-MA-SCHEDULE-VI.
